source.description:
PROBLEM: xtrm PR 119 amendment (merged 2026-09-08) makes /specialists the public operator vocabulary. Specialists HEAD still registers /fleet, /fleet:reply, /fleet:stop and the collapsed hint names /fleet inspect. Public surface contradicts the normative design.

SUCCESS: Operator commands read as the /specialists surface (inspect, reply, resume, stop); collapsed hint and help name /specialists; old /fleet names keep working as compat aliases or are removed per operator call recorded in notes; no dead /fleet references in help, hints, or tests.

SCOPE: Specialists repo only: config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs command registrations plus collapsed hint strings, and tests/unit/pi/specialist-subagents-extension.test.ts. Compose with the sibling resume-command bead if it lands first; do not duplicate it.

NON_GOALS: Model tool names (specialist_list, specialist_dispatch, specialist_status, specialist_reply, specialist_resume, specialist_stop_activation stay); footer seam; inspector overlay; Claude-side surface.

CONSTRAINTS: Existing width and overflow budgets hold. Suite green, tsc clean. Cross-frontend parity rule applies to any wording both frontends share. Every dispatch under unitAI-beqby passes model_override opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.

VALIDATION: Unit tests assert the /specialists commands are registered, hints name /specialists, and no /fleet string remains in user-facing help or hints (plus alias test if aliases are kept). Operator live check of inspect plus reply/stop in the TUI, recorded in notes.

OUTPUT: Commit on a specialists branch, operator confirmation recorded in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
